UserAccount.title: UserAccount
UserAccount.description: Registered applicant or super admin account with subscription expiration timestamp.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID matching the document ID.

displayName.description: Display name shown in the workspace and admin table.

role.description: Authorization role. Super admin is restricted to the configured owner email.

paidUntil.description: Firestore timestamp until which the user has paid access, or null.

lastRedeemedCode.description: Most recently redeemed license code ID, or null.

freeUsed.description: Number of free tailored CV and motivation letter packages used upon registration (0 to 3 free limit).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the user record was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the user record was last updated.

LicenseCode.title: LicenseCode
LicenseCode.description: Single-use license code created by super admin and redeemed atomically by a paying user.

code.description: License code string matching the document ID (e.g. K7P2-9XQ4).

used.description: Whether the code has already been redeemed.

durationDays.description: Number of days of access granted upon redemption (1 to 3650).

note.description: Optional admin note such as buyer name or WhatsApp reference.

createdBy.description: UID of the super admin who created the code.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the code was generated.

usedBy.description: UID of the user who redeemed the code, or null.

usedByEmail.description: Email of the user who redeemed the code, or null.

usedAt.description: Server timestamp when the code was redeemed, or null.

/users/{userId}.description: Stores registered users, roles, and paidUntil timestamps.

/codes/{codeId}.description: Stores single-use license codes issued by super admin for WhatsApp distribution.
